motivation: The plain lexical semantic probe performs poorly. Test explicit separation of quoted content from its surrounding assertion frame, so words inside a quote do not dominate the representation of the speaker's stance toward that quote.
training: Same 19202 TRAIN prefixes and eligible development as semantic-sparse-16. No calibration, challenge or regression data is fitted or used for feature selection.
representation: Mechanical paired quotation segmentation using guillemets, curly double quotes, Romanian low quotes and ASCII double quotes. Keep the original text as a separate channel. No language-specific keyword rules, case exceptions or label changes.
normalization: L2 normalize log-count features independently within each channel, apply the declared weights, then L2 normalize the combined 32768-dimensional vector.
outputs: Semantic marginals only; the neural binary review decision remains separate.
